tEn: Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models
tZh: 阐明基于扩散的生成模型的设计空间
sEn: We present a clear design space for diffusion-based generative models, yielding new state-of-the-art FID scores on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-64 with faster sampling.
sZh: 我们提出了一个清晰的设计空间，在CIFAR-10和ImageNet-64上取得了新的最先进FID分数，且采样速度更快。
absEn: We argue that the theory and practice of diffusion-based generative models are currently unnecessarily convoluted and seek to remedy the situation by presenting a design space that clearly separates the concrete design choices. This lets us identify several changes to both the sampling and training processes, as well as preconditioning of the score networks. Together, our improvements yield new state-of-the-art FID of 1.79 for CIFAR-10 in a class-conditional setting and 1.97 in an unconditional setting, with much faster sampling (35 network evaluations per image) than prior designs. To further demonstrate their modular nature, we show that our design changes dramatically improve both the efficiency and quality obtainable with pre-trained score networks from previous work, including improving the FID of a previously trained ImageNet-64 model from 2.07 to near-SOTA 1.55, and after re-training with our proposed improvements to a new SOTA of 1.36.
absZh: 我们认为，当前基于扩散的生成模型的理论与实践不必要地复杂，并试图通过呈现一个明确区分具体设计选择的设计空间来改善这一状况。这使我们能够识别出采样和训练过程中的几处变更，以及对分数网络的预处理。总之，我们的改进在类条件设置下为CIFAR-10取得了新的最先进FID 1.79，在无条件设置下为1.97，并且采样速度远快于先前设计（每张图像仅需35次网络评估）。为进一步展示其模块化特性，我们表明我们的设计变更显著提高了先前工作中预训练分数网络的效率和质量，包括将先前训练的ImageNet-64模型的FID从2.07提升至接近最先进的1.55，并在使用我们提出的改进重新训练后达到新的最先进水平1.36。

contrib.en: Presents a modular design space for diffusion-based generative models, decoupling sampling, training, and score-network preconditioning choices.
contrib.zh: 提出了扩散生成模型的模块化设计空间，将采样、训练与 score 网络预处理选择解耦。

contrib.en: Develops an improved deterministic sampler using a Heun 2nd-order integrator, optimized noise schedule, and sigma(t)=t, drastically reducing network evaluations.
contrib.zh: 开发了改进的确定性采样器：采用 Heun 二阶积分器、优化噪声时间表和 sigma(t)=t，大幅减少网络评估次数。

contrib.en: Proposes a tailored stochastic sampler with explicit noise churn and heuristic controls, correcting earlier sampling errors while noting empirical tuning requirements.
contrib.zh: 提出定制的随机采样器，通过显式噪声搅动与启发式控制纠正早前采样误差，同时指出需经验调参。

contrib.en: Derives principled preconditioning for inputs, outputs, skip connections, and noise conditioning, plus a log-normal training noise distribution and loss weighting.
contrib.zh: 为输入、输出、跳跃连接和噪声条件推导出有原理依据的预处理方案，并提出对数正态训练噪声分布与损失加权。

contrib.en: Achieves state-of-the-art FID: 1.79 class-conditional and 1.97 unconditional CIFAR-10, and 1.36 ImageNet-64 with only 35 network evaluations for CIFAR-10.
contrib.zh: 取得 SOTA FID：CIFAR-10 条件 1.79、无条件 1.97，ImageNet-64 1.36；CIFAR-10 每图仅需 35 次网络评估。

limits.en: The stochastic sampler relies on heuristic parameters that must be grid-searched per model and dataset, limiting generalization.
limits.zh: 随机采样器依赖对每个模型和数据集逐个网格搜索的启发式参数，泛化受限。

limits.en: Stochasticity is not universally beneficial: with improved CIFAR-10 training it hurts performance, while it helps ImageNet-64, leaving its interaction with training unresolved.
limits.zh: 随机性并非普遍有益：改进的训练下 CIFAR-10 上反而有害，而 ImageNet-64 上仍有效，其与训练目标的交互仍未解决。

limits.en: Many proposed parameter values likely need readjustment for higher-resolution datasets and different architectures.
limits.zh: 许多提议的参数值可能需针对更高分辨率数据集与不同架构重新调整。

limits.en: Excessive churn in stochastic sampling causes loss of detail and oversaturation, partly attributed to non-conservative learned score fields.
limits.zh: 随机采样中过度搅动会导致细节丢失与过饱和，部分归因于学得的 score 场非保守。

limits.en: Training consumed about 250 MWh and advances may amplify misinformation and bias in large-scale deployment.
limits.zh: 训练消耗约 250 MWh 电力；成果可能放大大规模部署中的虚假信息与偏见。

paras.en:
Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models

Tero Karras, Miika Aittala, Timo Aila, Samuli Laine — NVIDIA

We argue that the theory and practice of diffusion-based generative models are currently unnecessarily convoluted and seek to remedy the situation by presenting a design space that clearly separates the concrete design choices. This lets us identify several changes to both the sampling and training processes, as well as preconditioning of the score networks. Together, our improvements yield new state-of-the-art FID of 1.79 for CIFAR-10 in a class-conditional setting and 1.97 in an unconditional setting, with much faster sampling (35 network evaluations per image) than prior designs. To further demonstrate their modular nature, we show that our design changes dramatically improve both the efficiency and quality obtainable with pre-trained score networks from previous work, including improving the FID of a previously trained ImageNet-64 model from 2.07 to near-SOTA 1.55, and after re-training with our proposed improvements to a new SOTA of 1.36.
paras.zh:
阐明基于扩散的生成模型的设计空间

Tero Karras、Miika Aittala、Timo Aila、Samuli Laine（NVIDIA）

我们认为，基于扩散的生成模型的理论与实践目前过于复杂，我们试图通过呈现一个清晰分离具体设计选择的设计空间来改善这一状况。这使我们能够对采样和训练过程以及分数网络的预处理进行若干改进。综合来看，我们的改进在 CIFAR-10 上实现了新的最先进 FID 1.79（类条件设置）和 1.97（无条件设置），并且采样速度远快于先前设计（每张图像仅需 35 次网络评估）。为进一步展示其模块化特性，我们表明我们的设计变更显著提升了先前工作中预训练分数网络所能获得的效率和质量，包括将先前训练的 ImageNet-64 模型的 FID 从 2.07 提高到接近 SOTA 的 1.55，并在使用我们提出的改进重新训练后达到新的 SOTA 1.36。

paras.zh: 阐明基于扩散的生成模型的设计空间

paras.en: Diffusion-based generative models [46] have emerged as a powerful new framework for neural image synthesis, in both unconditional [16, 37, 49] and conditional [17, 36, 37, 39, 40, 42, 43, 49] settings, even surpassing the quality of GANs [13] in certain situations [9]. They are also rapidly finding use in other domains such as audio [28, 38] and video [19] generation, image segmentation [4, 57], and language translation [35]. As such, there is great interest in applying these models and improving them further in terms of image/distribution quality, training cost, and generation speed. The literature on these models is dense on theory, and derivations of sampling schedule, training dynamics, noise level parameterization, etc., tend to be based as directly as possible on theoretical frameworks, which ensures that the models are on a solid theoretical footing. However, this approach has a danger of obscuring the available design space — a proposed model may appear as a tightly coupled package where no individual component can be modified without breaking the entire system. As our first contribution, we take a look at the theory behind these models from a practical standpoint, focusing more on the “tangible” objects and algorithms that appear in the training and sampling phases, and less on the statistical processes from which they might be derived. The goal is to obtain better insights into how these components are linked together and what degrees of freedom are available in the design of the overall system. We focus on the broad class of models where a neural network is used to model the score [22] of a noise-level-dependent marginal distribution of the training data corrupted by Gaussian noise. Thus, our work is in the context of denoising score matching [54]. Our second set of contributions concerns the sampling processes used to synthesize images using diffusion models. We identify the best-performing time discretization for sampling, apply a higher-order Runge–Kutta method for the sampling process, evaluate different sampler schedules, and analyze the usefulness of stochasticity in the sampling process. The result of these improvements is a significant drop in the number of sampling steps required during synthesis, and the improved sampler can be used as a drop-in replacement with several widely used diffusion models [37, 49].
paras.zh: 基于扩散的生成模型 [46] 已成为神经图像合成的一种强大新框架，在无条件 [16, 37, 49] 和条件 [17, 36, 37, 39, 40, 42, 43, 49] 两种设置下都表现出色，甚至在某些情况下超越了 GAN [13] 的质量 [9]。它们也正迅速在音频 [28, 38] 和视频 [19] 生成、图像分割 [4, 57] 以及语言翻译 [35] 等其他领域得到应用。因此，人们对应用这些模型并进一步提升其图像/分布质量、降低训练成本和提高生成速度有着浓厚的兴趣。关于这些模型的文献理论性很强，采样调度、训练动态、噪声水平参数化等推导往往尽可能直接基于理论框架，这确保了模型具有坚实的理论基础。然而，这种方法有可能掩盖可用的设计空间——一个被提出的模型可能看起来像一个紧密耦合的整体，任何单个组件都无法在不破坏整个系统的情况下被修改。作为我们的第一个贡献，我们从实践的角度审视这些模型背后的理论，更多地关注训练和采样阶段中出现的“有形”对象和算法，而不是它们可能被推导出的统计过程。目标是更好地理解这些组件如何联系在一起，以及整个系统设计中存在哪些自由度。我们关注一大类模型：用神经网络对由高斯噪声破坏的训练数据的、依赖于噪声水平的边际分布的得分 [22] 进行建模。因此，我们的工作属于去噪得分匹配 [54] 的范畴。我们的第二组贡献涉及使用扩散模型合成图像的采样过程。我们确定了采样中表现最好的时间离散化，将高阶龙格-库塔法应用于采样过程，评估了不同的采样器调度，并分析了采样过程中随机性的作用。这些改进的结果是合成过程中所需采样步数大幅减少，且改进后的采样器可以作为几种广泛使用的扩散模型 [37, 49] 的直接替代品。

paras.en: The third set of contributions focuses on the training of the score-modeling neural network. While we continue to rely on the commonly used network architectures (DDPM [16], NCSN [48]), we provide the first principled analysis of the preconditioning of the networks’ inputs, outputs, and loss functions in a diffusion model setting and derive best practices for improving the training dynamics. We also suggest an improved distribution of noise levels during training, and note that non-leaking augmentation [25] — typically used with GANs — is beneficial for diffusion models as well. Taken together, our contributions enable significant improvements in result quality, e.g., leading to record FIDs of 1.79 for CIFAR-10 [29] and 1.36 for ImageNet [8] in 64×64 resolution. With all key ingredients of the design space explicitly tabulated, we believe that our approach will allow easier innovation on the individual components, and thus enable more extensive and targeted exploration of the design space of diffusion models. Our implementation and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/NVlabs/edm
paras.zh: 第三组贡献聚焦于得分建模神经网络的训练。虽然我们继续使用常用的网络架构（DDPM [16]、NCSN [48]），但我们首次对扩散模型设置中网络输入、输出和损失函数的预条件化（preconditioning）进行了原则性分析，并推导出改善训练动态的最佳实践。我们还提出了一种改进的训练期间噪声水平分布，并指出通常用于 GAN 的非泄漏增强 [25] 对扩散模型同样有益。总的来说，我们的贡献显著提升了结果质量，例如在 CIFAR-10 [29] 上取得了 1.79 的创纪录 FID，在 64×64 分辨率的 ImageNet [8] 上取得了 1.36 的创纪录 FID。通过将所有关键设计空间要素明确列成表格，我们相信我们的方法将使得对各个组件的创新更加容易，从而能够对扩散模型的设计空间进行更广泛、更有针对性的探索。我们的实现和预训练模型可在 https://github.com/NVlabs/edm 获取。

full.sec: 2 Expressing diffusion models in a common framework
full.secZh: 2 Expressing diffusion models in a common framework

paras.en: Let us denote the data distribution by pdata(x), with standard deviation σdata, and consider the family of mollified distributions p(x; σ) obtained by adding i.i.d. Gaussian noise of standard deviation σ to the data. For σmax ≫ σdata, p(x; σmax) is practically indistinguishable from pure Gaussian noise. The idea of diffusion models is to randomly sample a noise image x0 ∼ N(0, σmax²I), and sequentially denoise it into images xi with noise levels σ0 = σmax > σ1 > · · · > σN = 0 so that at each noise level xi ∼ p(xi; σi). The endpoint xN of this process is thus distributed according to the data. Song et al. [49] present a stochastic differential equation (SDE) that maintains the desired distribution p as sample x evolves over time. This allows the above process to be implemented using a stochastic solver that both removes and adds noise at each iteration. They also give a corresponding “probability flow” ordinary differential equation (ODE) where the only source of randomness is the initial noise image x0. Contrary to the usual order of treatment, we begin by examining the ODE, as it offers a fruitful setting for analyzing sampling trajectories and their discretizations. The insights carry over to stochastic sampling, which we reintroduce as a generalization in Section 4.
paras.zh: 设数据分布为 pdata(x)，标准差为 σdata，并考虑通过向数据添加独立同分布的高斯噪声（标准差为 σ）得到的平滑分布族 p(x; σ)。当 σmax ≫ σdata 时，p(x; σmax) 实际上与纯高斯噪声无法区分。扩散模型的思想是随机采样一个噪声图像 x0 ∼ N(0, σmax²I)，然后依次将其去噪为噪声水平为 σ0 = σmax > σ1 > · · · > σN = 0 的图像 xi，使得在每个噪声水平下 xi ∼ p(xi; σi)。因此，该过程的终点 xN 服从数据分布。Song 等人 [49] 提出了一个随机微分方程（SDE），在样本 x 随时间演化时保持所需的分布 p。这使得上述过程可以通过随机求解器实现，该求解器在每次迭代中同时去除和添加噪声。他们还给出了相应的“概率流”常微分方程（ODE），其中唯一的随机性来源是初始噪声图像 x0。与通常的处理顺序相反，我们首先考察 ODE，因为它为分析采样轨迹及其离散化提供了富有成效的框架。这些见解也适用于随机采样，我们将在第 4 节中将其作为推广重新引入。

paras.en: ODE formulation. A probability flow ODE [49] continuously increases or reduces noise level of the image when moving forward or backward in time, respectively. To specify the ODE, we must first choose a schedule σ(t) that defines the desired noise level at time t. For example, setting σ(t) ∝ √t is mathematically natural, as it corresponds to constant-speed heat diffusion [12]. However, we will show in Section 3 that the choice of schedule has major practical implications and should not be made on the basis of theoretical convenience. The defining characteristic of the probability flow ODE is that evolving a sample xa ∼ p(xa; σ(ta)) from time ta to tb (either forward or backward in time) yields a sample xb ∼ p(xb; σ(tb)). Following previous work [49], this requirement is satisfied (see Appendix B.1 and B.2) by dx = −σ̇(t) σ(t) ∇x log p(x; σ(t)) dt, (1) where the dot denotes a time derivative. ∇x log p(x; σ) is the score function [22], a vector field that points towards higher density of data at a given noise level. Intuitively, an infinitesimal forward step of this ODE nudges the sample away from the data, at a rate that depends on the change in noise level. Equivalently, a backward step nudges the sample towards the data distribution.
paras.zh: ODE 公式。概率流 ODE [49] 在时间向前或向后移动时分别连续增加或减少图像的噪声水平。为了指定 ODE，我们必须首先选择一个调度 σ(t)，它定义了在时间 t 所需的噪声水平。例如，设置 σ(t) ∝ √t 在数学上是自然的，因为它对应于匀速热扩散 [12]。然而，我们将在第 3 节中表明，调度的选择具有重大的实际意义，不应基于理论上的便利性来做出。概率流 ODE 的定义特征是：将样本 xa ∼ p(xa; σ(ta)) 从时间 ta 演化到 tb（无论是向前还是向后）得到样本 xb ∼ p(xb; σ(tb))。根据先前的工作 [49]，该要求由 dx = −σ̇(t) σ(t) ∇x log p(x; σ(t)) dt 满足（见附录 B.1 和 B.2），其中点表示时间导数。∇x log p(x; σ) 是得分函数 [22]，一个指向给定噪声水平下数据密度更高方向的向量场。直观地说，该 ODE 的无穷小前向步骤以取决于噪声水平变化的速率将样本推离数据。等价地，后向步骤将样本推向数据分布。

Some of our formulas appear quite different from the original papers as indirection and recursion have been removed; see Appendix C for details. The main purpose of this reframing is to bring into light all the independent components that often appear tangled together in previous work. In our framework, there are no implicit dependencies between the components — any choices (within reason) for the individual formulas will, in principle, lead to a functioning model. In other words, changing one component does not necessitate changes elsewhere in order to, e.g., maintain the property that the model converges to the data in the limit. In practice, some choices and combinations will of course work better than others.

paras.en: Improving the output quality and/or decreasing the computational cost of sampling are common topics in diffusion model research (e.g., [10, 24, 31, 32, 33, 37, 44, 53, 55, 56, 59]). Our hypothesis is that the choices related to the sampling process are largely independent of the other components, such as network architecture and training details. In other words, the training procedure of Dθ should not dictate σ(t), s(t), and {ti}, nor vice versa; from the viewpoint of the sampler, Dθ is simply a black box [55, 56]. We test this by evaluating different samplers on three pre-trained models, each representing a different theoretical framework and model family. We first measure baseline results for these models using their original sampler implementations, and then bring these samplers into our unified framework using the formulas in Table 1, followed by our improvements. This allows us to evaluate different practical choices and propose general improvements to the sampling process that are applicable to all models. We evaluate the “DDPM++ cont. (VP)” and “NCSN++ cont. (VE)” models by Song et al. [49] trained on unconditional CIFAR-10 [29] at 32×32, corresponding to the variance preserving (VP) and variance exploding (VE) formulations [49], originally inspired by DDPM [16] and SMLD [48]. We also evaluate the “ADM (dropout)” model by Dhariwal and Nichol [9] trained on class-conditional ImageNet [8] at 64×64, corresponding to the improved DDPM (iDDPM) formulation [37]. This model was trained using a discrete set of M = 1000 noise levels. Further details are given in Appendix C. We evaluate the result quality in terms of Fréchet inception distance (FID) [15] computed between 50,000 generated images and all available real images. Figure 2 shows FID as a function of neural function evaluations (NFE), i.e., how many times Dθ is evaluated to produce a single image. Given that the sampling process is dominated entirely by the cost of Dθ, improvements in NFE translate directly to sampling speed. The original deterministic samplers are shown in blue, and the reimplementations of these methods in our unified framework (orange) yield similar but consistently better results. The differences are explained by certain oversights in the original implementations as well as our more careful treatment of discrete noise levels in the case of DDIM; see Appendix C. Note that our reimplementations are fully specified by Algorithm 1 and Table 1, even though the original codebases are structured very differently from each other.

paras.en: evaluations of Dθ per step. Linear multistep methods have also been recently proposed for sampling diffusion models [31, 59]. Through extensive tests, we have found Heun’s 2nd order method [2] (a.k.a. improved Euler, trapezoidal rule) — previously explored in the context of diffusion models by Jolicoeur-Martineau et al. [24] — to provide an excellent tradeoff between truncation error and NFE. As illustrated in Algorithm 1, it introduces an additional correction step for xi+1 to account for change in dx/dt between ti and ti+1 . This correction leads to O(h3 ) local error at the cost of one additional evaluation of Dθ per step. Note that stepping to σ = 0 would result in a division by zero, so we revert to Euler’s method in this case. We discuss the general family of 2nd order solvers in Appendix D.2. The time steps {ti } determine how the step sizes and thus truncation errors are distributed between different noise levels. We provide a detailed analysis in Appendix D.1, concluding that the step size should decrease monotonically with decreasing σ and it does not need to vary on a per-sample basis. We adopt a parameterized scheme where the time steps are defined according to a sequence of noise levels {σi }, i.e., ti = σ −1 (σi ). We set σi<N = (Ai + B)ρ and select the constants A and B so that σ0 = σmax and σN −1 = σmin , which gives 1 1 1 \u0001ρ i σi<N = σmax ρ + N −1 (σmin ρ − σmax ρ ) and σN = 0. (5)

This suggests that errors near σmin have a large impact. We set ρ = 7 for the remainder of this paper. Results for Heun’s method and Eq. 5 are shown as the green curves in Figure 2. We observe consistent improvement in all cases: Heun’s method reaches the same FID as Euler’s method with considerably lower NFE.

paras.en: Trajectory curvature and noise schedule. The shape of the ODE solution trajectories is defined by functions \(\sigma(t)\) and \(s(t)\). The choice of these functions offers a way to reduce the truncation errors discussed above, as their magnitude can be expected to scale proportional to the curvature of \(\frac{dx}{dt}\). We argue that the best choice for these functions is \(\sigma(t) = t\) and \(s(t) = 1\), which is also the choice made in DDIM [47]. With this choice, the ODE of Eq. 4 simplifies to \(\frac{dx}{dt} = \frac{x - D(x; t)}{t}\), and \(\sigma\) and \(t\) become interchangeable. An immediate consequence is that at any \(x\) and \(t\), a single Euler step to \(t = 0\) yields the denoised image \(D_{\theta}(x; t)\). The tangent of the solution trajectory therefore always points towards the denoiser output. This can be expected to change only slowly with the noise level, which corresponds to largely linear solution trajectories. The 1D ODE sketch of Figure 3c supports this intuition; the solution trajectories approach linear at both large and small noise levels, and have substantial curvature in only a small region in between. The same effect can be seen with real data in Figure 1b, where the change between different denoiser targets occurs in a relatively narrow \(\sigma\) range. With the advocated schedule, this corresponds to high ODE curvature being limited to this same range. The effect of setting \(\sigma(t) = t\) and \(s(t) = 1\) is shown as the red curves in Figure 2. As DDIM already employs these same choices, the red curve is identical to the green one for ImageNet-64. However, VP and VE benefit considerably from switching away from their original schedules.
paras.zh: 轨迹曲率与噪声调度。ODE 解轨迹的形状由函数 \(\sigma(t)\) 和 \(s(t)\) 决定。选择这些函数提供了一种减少上述截断误差的方法，因为它们的幅度可以预期与 \(\frac{dx}{dt}\) 的曲率成比例缩放。我们认为这些函数的最佳选择是 \(\sigma(t) = t\) 和 \(s(t) = 1\)，这也是 DDIM [47] 中的选择。有了这一选择，式 (4) 的 ODE 简化为 \(\frac{dx}{dt} = \frac{x - D(x; t)}{t}\)，且 \(\sigma\) 与 \(t\) 可以互换。一个直接后果是，对于任意 \(x\) 和 \(t\)，单步欧拉到 \(t = 0\) 即可得到去噪图像 \(D_{\theta}(x; t)\)。因此，解轨迹的切线始终指向去噪器输出。可以预期，这只会随噪声水平缓慢变化，对应于大致线性的解轨迹。图 3c 的 1D ODE 示意图支持这一直觉；解轨迹在大噪声和小噪声水平下都趋于线性，而仅在中间的较小区域内具有显著曲率。真实数据中也可见到同样的效果，如图 1b 所示，不同去噪目标之间的变化发生在相对较窄的 \(\sigma\) 范围内。采用我们所主张的调度，高 ODE 曲率也就仅限于这一范围。设置 \(\sigma(t) = t\) 和 \(s(t) = 1\) 的效果如图 2 中的红色曲线所示。由于 DDIM 已经采用了这些相同的选择，因此红色曲线与 ImageNet-64 的绿色曲线完全相同。然而，VP 和 VE 通过放弃其原始调度而获得了显著改进。

paras.en: Discussion. The choices that we made in this section to improve deterministic sampling are summarized in the Sampling part of Table 1. Together, they reduce the NFE needed to reach high-quality results by a large factor: 7.3× for VP, 300× for VE, and 3.2× for DDIM, corresponding to the highlighted NFE values in Figure 2. In practice, we can generate 26.3 high-quality CIFAR-10 images per second on a single NVIDIA V100. The consistency of improvements corroborates our hypothesis that the sampling process is orthogonal to how each model was originally trained. As further validation, we show results for the adaptive RK45 method [11] using our schedule as the dashed black curves in Figure 2; the cost of this sophisticated ODE solver outweighs its benefits.
paras.zh: 讨论。本节为改进确定性采样所做的选择总结在表 1 的 Sampling 部分。它们共同将获得高质量结果所需的 NFE 大幅减少：VP 为 7.3 倍，VE 为 300 倍，DDIM 为 3.2 倍，对应图 2 中突出显示的 NFE 值。在实践中，我们可以在单个 NVIDIA V100 上每秒生成 26.3 张高质量的 CIFAR-10 图像。改进的一致性证实了我们的假设：采样过程与各模型的原始训练方式正交。作为进一步验证，我们在图 2 中用黑色虚线展示了使用我们调度的自适应 RK45 方法 [11] 的结果；这种复杂 ODE 求解器的成本超过了其收益。

paras.en: Deterministic sampling offers many benefits, e.g., the ability to turn real images into their corresponding latent representations by inverting the ODE. However, it tends to lead to worse output quality [47, 49] than stochastic sampling that injects fresh noise into the image in each step. Given that ODEs and SDEs recover the same distributions in theory, what exactly is the role of stochasticity?
paras.zh: 确定性采样具有诸多优点，例如能够通过反转ODE将真实图像转换为对应的潜在表示。然而，它往往导致比随机采样更差的输出质量[47, 49]，后者在每一步向图像注入新的噪声。鉴于在理论上ODE和SDE恢复相同的分布，随机性的确切作用是什么？

paras.en: Background. The SDEs of Song et al. [49] can be generalized [20, 58] as a sum of the probability flow ODE of Eq. 1 and a time-varying Langevin diffusion SDE [14] (see Appendix B.5): \[ dx_{\pm} = -\dot{\sigma}(t)\sigma(t)\nabla_x \log p(x; \sigma(t))\, dt \pm \beta(t)\sigma(t)^2 \nabla_x \log p(x; \sigma(t))\, dt + \sqrt{2\beta(t)}\sigma(t)\, d\omega_t, \tag{6} \] where the first term is the probability flow ODE (Eq. 1), the second is deterministic noise decay, and the third is noise injection; together they form the Langevin diffusion SDE.
paras.zh: 背景。Song等人[49]的SDE可以推广[20, 58]为公式(1)的概率流ODE与一个时变Langevin扩散SDE[14]之和（见附录B.5）：\[ dx_{\pm} = -\dot{\sigma}(t)\sigma(t)\nabla_x \log p(x; \sigma(t))\, dt \pm \beta(t)\sigma(t)^2 \nabla_x \log p(x; \sigma(t))\, dt + \sqrt{2\beta(t)}\sigma(t)\, d\omega_t, \tag{6} \] 其中第一项为概率流ODE（公式1），第二项为确定性噪声衰减，第三项为噪声注入；它们共同构成Langevin扩散SDE。

paras.en: where $\omega_t$ is the standard Wiener process. $dx_+$ and $dx_-$ are now separate SDEs for moving forward and backward in time, related by the time reversal formula of Anderson [1]. The Langevin term can further be seen as a combination of a deterministic score-based denoising term and a stochastic noise injection term, whose net noise level contributions cancel out. As such, $\beta(t)$ effectively expresses the relative rate at which existing noise is replaced with new noise. The SDEs of Song et al. [49] are recovered with the choice $\beta(t) = \dot{\sigma}(t)/\sigma(t)$, whereby the score vanishes from the forward SDE. This perspective reveals why stochasticity is helpful in practice: The implicit Langevin diffusion drives the sample towards the desired marginal distribution at a given time, actively correcting for any errors made in earlier sampling steps. On the other hand, approximating the Langevin term with discrete SDE solver steps introduces error in itself. Previous results [3, 24, 47, 49] suggest that non-zero $\beta(t)$ is helpful, but as far as we can tell, the implicit choice for $\beta(t)$ in Song et al. [49] enjoys no special properties. Hence, the optimal amount of stochasticity should be determined empirically.
paras.zh: 其中 \(\omega_t\) 是标准Wiener过程。\(dx_+\) 和 \(dx_-\) 现在是分别用于时间前向和后向的独立SDE，它们通过Anderson[1]的时间反转公式相关联。Langevin项可以进一步视为确定性基于分数的去噪项与随机噪声注入项的组合，其净噪声水平贡献相互抵消。因此，\(\beta(t)\) 有效地表达了现有噪声被新噪声替换的相对速率。选择 \(\beta(t) = \dot{\sigma}(t)/\sigma(t)\) 可恢复Song等人[49]的SDE，此时分数从前向SDE中消失。这一视角揭示了随机性在实践中为何有帮助：隐式Langevin扩散将样本驱动到给定时间所需的边际分布，主动纠正早期采样步骤中的任何错误。另一方面，用离散SDE求解器步骤近似Langevin项本身也会引入误差。先前的结果[3, 24, 47, 49]表明非零的 \(\beta(t)\) 是有帮助的，但据我们所知，Song等人[49]中隐式选择的 \(\beta(t)\) 并无特殊性质。因此，最优的随机性程度应通过经验确定。

paras.en: sub-steps. First, we add noise to the sample according to a factor γi ≥ 0 to reach a higher noise level t̂i = ti + γi ti . Second, from the increased-noise sample x̂i , we solve the ODE backward from t̂i to ti+1 with a single step. This yields a sample xi+1 with noise level ti+1 , and the iteration continues. We stress that this is not a general-purpose SDE solver, but a sampling procedure tailored for the specific problem. Its correctness stems from the alternation of two sub-steps that each maintain the correct distribution (up to truncation error in the ODE step). The predictor-corrector sampler of Song et al. [49] has a conceptually similar structure to ours. To analyze the main difference between our method and Euler–Maruyama, we first note a subtle discrepancy in the latter when discretizing Eq. 6. One can interpret Euler–Maruyama as first adding noise and then performing an ODE step, not from the intermediate state after noise injection, but assuming that x and σ remained at the initial state at the beginning of the iteration step. In our method, the parameters used to evaluate Dθ on line 7 of Algorithm 2 correspond to the state after noise injection, whereas an Euler–Maruyama -like method would use xi ; ti instead of x̂i ; t̂i . In the limit of ∆t approaching zero there may be no difference between these choices, but the distinction appears to become significant when pursuing low NFE with large steps.
paras.zh: 子步骤。首先，我们根据因子 γi ≥ 0 向样本添加噪声，以达到更高的噪声水平 t̂i = ti + γi ti。其次，从增加噪声后的样本 x̂i 出发，我们通过单步从 t̂i 向后求解 ODE 到 ti+1。这产生一个噪声水平为 ti+1 的样本 xi+1，然后迭代继续。我们强调，这不是一个通用的 SDE 求解器，而是针对特定问题定制的采样过程。其正确性源于两个子步骤的交替，每个子步骤都保持正确的分布（在 ODE 步的截断误差范围内）。Song 等人 [49] 的预测-校正采样器在概念上与我们的结构相似。为了分析我们的方法与 Euler–Maruyama 方法的主要区别，我们首先注意到后者在离散化方程 6 时的一个细微差异。可以将 Euler–Maruyama 解释为先添加噪声，然后执行 ODE 步，但不是从噪声注入后的中间状态出发，而是假设 x 和 σ 在迭代步骤开始时保持在初始状态。在我们的方法中，用于在算法2第7行评估 Dθ 的参数对应于噪声注入后的状态，而类似 Euler–Maruyama 的方法会使用 xi; ti 而不是 x̂i; t̂i。在 ∆t 趋近于零的极限下，这些选择可能没有区别，但在追求低 NFE 和大步长时，这种区别似乎变得显著。

paras.en: Practical considerations. Increasing the amount of stochasticity is effective in correcting errors made by earlier sampling steps, but it has its own drawbacks. We have observed (see Appendix E.1) that excessive Langevin-like addition and removal of noise results in gradual loss of detail in the generated images with all datasets and denoiser networks. There is also a drift toward oversaturated colors at very low and high noise levels. We suspect that practical denoisers induce a slightly nonconservative vector field in Eq. 3, violating the premises of Langevin diffusion and causing these detrimental effects. Notably, our experiments with analytical denoisers (such as the one in Figure 1b) have not shown such degradation. If the degradation is caused by flaws in Dθ (x; σ), they can only be remedied using heuristic means during sampling. We address the drift toward oversaturated colors by only enabling stochasticity within a specific range of noise levels ti ∈ [Stmin , Stmax ]. For these noise levels, we define γi = Schurn /N , where Schurn controls the overall amount of stochasticity. We further clamp γi to never introduce more new noise than what is already present in the image. Finally, we have found that the loss of detail can be partially counteracted by setting Snoise slightly above 1 to inflate the standard deviation for the newly added noise. This suggests that a major component of the hypothesized non-conservativity of Dθ (x; σ) is a tendency to remove slightly too much noise — most likely due to regression toward the mean that can be expected to happen with any L2 -trained denoiser [30].
paras.zh: 实际考虑。增加随机性量能有效纠正早期采样步骤产生的错误，但也有其自身的缺点。我们观察到（见附录E.1），过度的类似Langevin的噪声添加和去除会导致生成图像细节逐渐丢失，这在所有数据集和去噪器网络上均如此。此外，在极低和极高噪声水平下，还会出现向过饱和颜色漂移的现象。我们怀疑实际去噪器在公式3中引入了轻微非保守的向量场，违反了Langevin扩散的前提条件，从而导致了这些不利影响。值得注意的是，我们使用解析去噪器（如图1b所示）的实验并未表现出这种退化。如果退化是由Dθ (x; σ)的缺陷引起的，那么只能在采样过程中通过启发式手段加以补救。我们通过仅在特定噪声水平范围 ti ∈ [Stmin , Stmax ] 内启用随机性来解决向过饱和颜色漂移的问题。对于这些噪声水平，我们定义 γi = Schurn /N ，其中 Schurn 控制整体随机性量。我们进一步限制 γi ，使其引入的新噪声不超过图像中已有的噪声。最后，我们发现将 Snoise 设置为略高于1以增大新添加噪声的标准差，可以部分抵消细节丢失。这表明假设的Dθ (x; σ)非保守性的一个主要成分是倾向于去除略多的噪声——这很可能归因于任何L2训练的去噪器[30]都可能出现的均值回归现象。

paras.en: Evaluation. Figure 4 shows that our stochastic sampler outperforms previous samplers [24, 37, 49] by a significant margin, especially at low step counts. Jolicoeur-Martineau et al. [24] use a standard higher-order adaptive SDE solver [41] and its performance is a good baseline for such solvers in general. Our sampler has been tailored to the use case by, e.g., performing noise injection and ODE step sequentially, and it is not adaptive. It is an open question if adaptive solvers can be a net win over a well-tuned fixed schedule in sampling diffusion models. Through sampler improvements alone, we are able to bring the ImageNet-64 model that originally achieved FID 2.07 [9] to 1.55 that is very close to the state-of-the-art; previously, FID 1.48 has been

paras.en: reported for cascaded diffusion [17], 1.55 for classifier-free guidance [18], and 1.52 for StyleGANXL [45]. While our results showcase the potential gains achievable through sampler improvements, they also highlight the main shortcoming of stochasticity: For best results, one must make several heuristic choices — either implicit or explicit — that depend on the specific model. Indeed, we had to find the optimal values of {Schurn , Stmin , Stmax , Snoise } on a case-by-case basis using grid search (Appendix E.2). This raises a general concern that using stochastic sampling as the primary means of evaluating model improvements may inadvertently end up influencing the design choices related to model architecture and training.

paras.en: There are various known good practices for training neural networks in a supervised fashion. For example, it is advisable to keep input and output signal magnitudes fixed to, e.g., unit variance, and to avoid large variation in gradient magnitudes on a per-sample basis [5, 21]. Training a neural network to model D directly would be far from ideal — for example, as the input x = y + n is a combination of clean signal y and noise n ∼ N (0, σ 2 I), its magnitude varies immensely depending on noise level σ. For this reason, the common practice is to not represent Dθ as a neural network directly, but instead train a different network Fθ from which Dθ is derived. Previous methods [37, 47, 49] address the input scaling via a σ-dependent normalization factor and attempt to precondition the output by training Fθ to predict n scaled to unit variance, from which the signal is then reconstructed via Dθ (x; σ) = x − σFθ (·). This has the drawback that at large σ, the network needs to fine-tune its output carefully to cancel out the existing noise n exactly and give the output at the correct scale; note that any errors made by the network are amplified by a factor of σ. In this situation, it would seem much easier to predict the expected output D(x; σ) directly. In the same spirit as previous parameterizations that adaptively mix signal and noise (e.g., [10, 44, 53]), we propose to precondition the neural network with a σ-dependent skip connection that allows it to estimate either y or n, or something in between. We thus write Dθ in the following form: \[ Dθ (x; σ) = cskip (σ) x + cout (σ) Fθ cin (σ) x; cnoise (σ) , (7) \] where Fθ is the neural network to be trained, cskip (σ) modulates the skip connection, cin (σ) and cout (σ) scale the input and output magnitudes, and cnoise (σ) maps noise level σ into a conditioning input for Fθ . Taking a weighted expectation of Eq. 2 over the noise levels gives the overall training loss Eσ,y,n λ(σ) kD(y + n; σ) − yk22 , where σ ∼ ptrain , y ∼ pdata , and n ∼ N (0, σ 2 I). The probability of sampling a given noise level σ is given by ptrain (σ) and the corresponding weight is given by λ(σ). We can equivalently express this loss with respect to the raw network output Fθ in Eq. 7: \[ Eσ,y,n λ(σ) cout (σ)2 Fθ cin (σ) · (y + n); cnoise (σ) − cout1(σ) y − cskip (σ) · (y + n) 2 . (8) \] | {z } | {z } | {z } effective weight network output effective training target
paras.zh: 在监督方式下训练神经网络有许多已知的良好实践。例如，建议将输入和输出信号的幅度保持固定（如单位方差），并避免每个样本的梯度幅度出现大的变化 [5, 21]。直接训练神经网络来建模 D 远非理想——例如，由于输入 x = y + n 是干净信号 y 和噪声 n ∼ N (0, σ 2 I) 的组合，其幅度随噪声水平 σ 变化极大。因此，通常的做法不是直接将 Dθ 表示为神经网络，而是训练另一个网络 Fθ，从中导出 Dθ。先前的方法 [37, 47, 49] 通过依赖 σ 的归一化因子处理输入缩放，并尝试通过训练 Fθ 预测缩放至单位方差的 n 来对输出进行预条件，然后通过 Dθ (x; σ) = x − σFθ (·) 重建信号。这有一个缺点：在 σ 较大时，网络需要仔细微调其输出以精确抵消现有噪声 n，并以正确的尺度给出输出；注意网络产生的任何误差都会被因子 σ 放大。在这种情况下，直接预测期望输出 D(x; σ) 似乎容易得多。与先前自适应混合信号和噪声的参数化方法（例如 [10, 44, 53]）精神一致，我们提出用依赖 σ 的跳跃连接对神经网络进行预条件，使其能够估计 y 或 n，或介于两者之间的量。因此我们将 Dθ 写成如下形式：\[ Dθ (x; σ) = cskip (σ) x + cout (σ) Fθ cin (σ) x; cnoise (σ) , (7) \] 其中 Fθ 是要训练的网络，cskip (σ) 调节跳跃连接，cin (σ) 和 cout (σ) 缩放输入和输出的幅度，cnoise (σ) 将噪声水平 σ 映射为 Fθ 的条件输入。对噪声水平取加权期望，得到总体训练损失 Eσ,y,n λ(σ) kD(y + n; σ) − yk22 ，其中 σ ∼ ptrain ，y ∼ pdata ，n ∼ N (0, σ 2 I)。采样给定噪声水平 σ 的概率由 ptrain (σ) 给出，相应的权重由 λ(σ) 给出。我们可以等价地用式 (7) 中的原始网络输出 Fθ 来表达该损失：\[ Eσ,y,n λ(σ) cout (σ)2 Fθ cin (σ) · (y + n); cnoise (σ) − cout1(σ) y − cskip (σ) · (y + n) 2 . (8) \] | {z } | {z } | {z } 有效权重 网络输出 有效训练目标

paras.en: Loss weighting and sampling. Eq. 8 shows that training Fθ as preconditioned in Eq. 7 incurs an effective per-sample loss weight of λ(σ)cout(σ)². To balance the effective loss weights, we set λ(σ) = 1/cout(σ)², which also equalizes the initial training loss over the entire σ range as shown in Figure 5a (green curve). Finally, we need to select ptrain(σ), i.e., how to choose noise levels during training. Inspecting the per-σ loss after training (blue and orange curves) reveals that a significant reduction is possible only at intermediate noise levels; at very low levels, it is both difficult and irrelevant to discern the vanishingly small noise component, whereas at high levels the training targets are always dissimilar from the correct answer that approaches dataset average. Therefore, we target the training efforts to the relevant range using a simple log-normal distribution for ptrain(σ) as detailed in Table 1 and illustrated in Figure 5a (red curve). Table 2 shows that our proposed ptrain and λ (config E) lead to a dramatic improvement in FID in all cases when used in conjunction with our preconditioning (config D). In concurrent work, Choi et al. [6] propose a similar scheme to prioritize noise levels that are most relevant w.r.t. forming the perceptually recognizable content of the image. However, they only consider the choice of λ in isolation, which results in a smaller overall improvement.
paras.zh: 损失加权与采样。式(8)表明，按式(7)预处理的Fθ训练会产生有效的每样本损失权重λ(σ)cout(σ)²。为了平衡有效损失权重，我们设置λ(σ) = 1/cout(σ)²，这也使得整个σ范围内的初始训练损失相等，如图5a（绿色曲线）所示。最后，我们需要选择ptrain(σ)，即训练期间如何选择噪声水平。检查训练后的每σ损失（蓝色和橙色曲线）表明，只有在中间噪声水平才能实现显著的降低；在非常低的水平，辨别微小的噪声分量既困难又不相关，而在高水平，训练目标总是与接近数据集平均值的正确答案不同。因此，我们使用简单的对数正态分布将训练工作集中在相关范围内，如表1所述和图5a（红色曲线）所示。表2显示，我们提出的ptrain和λ（配置E）与我们的预处理（配置D）结合使用时，在所有情况下都显著改善了FID。在同时进行的工作中，Choi等人[6]提出了类似的方案，优先考虑与形成图像感知可识别内容最相关的噪声水平。然而，他们只孤立地考虑λ的选择，导致整体改进较小。

paras.en: **Augmentation regularization.** To prevent the potential overfitting that often plagues diffusion models when trained on smaller datasets, we borrow an augmentation pipeline from the GAN literature [25]. The pipeline consists of various geometric transformations (see Appendix F.2) that are applied to a training image before noise is added. To prevent the augmentations from leaking into the generated images, we provide the augmentation parameters as a conditioning input to \(F_{\theta}\); during inference we set them to zero, ensuring that only non-augmented images are generated. Table 2 shows that data augmentation gives a consistent improvement (config F) and yields new state-of-the-art FIDs of 1.79 and 1.97 for conditional and unconditional CIFAR-10, beating the previous records of 1.85 [45] and 2.10 [53].
paras.zh: **增强正则化。** 为抑制扩散模型在较小数据集上常见的过拟合，我们从 GAN 文献 [25] 借鉴了一条增强流水线。该流水线包含多种几何变换（见附录 F.2），我们在加入噪声之前将其应用于训练图像。为防止增强泄漏到生成图像中，我们将增强参数作为条件输入提供给 \(F_{\theta}\)；在推理时将它们设为零，以保证只生成未经增强的图像。表 2 显示，数据增强带来了一致的改进（配置 F），在条件和无条件 CIFAR-10 上分别取得了新的最先进 FID 1.79 和 1.97，超过了此前 1.85 [45] 和 2.10 [53] 的记录。

paras.en: **Stochastic sampling revisited.** Interestingly, the relevance of stochastic sampling appears to diminish as the model itself improves, as shown in Figure 5b,c. When using our training setup on CIFAR-10 (Figure 5b), the best results were obtained with deterministic sampling, and any amount of stochastic sampling was detrimental.
paras.zh: **重新审视随机采样。** 有趣的是，随机采样的重要性似乎随模型本身性能提升而下降，如图 5b、c 所示。当我们在 CIFAR-10 上使用自己的训练方案（图 5b）时，最佳结果来自确定性采样，任何程度的随机采样都会造成损害。

paras.en: Our approach of putting diffusion models into a common framework exposes a modular design. This allows a targeted investigation of individual components, potentially helping to better cover the viable design space. In our tests, this let us simply replace the samplers in various earlier models, drastically improving the results. For example, on ImageNet-64, our sampler turned an average model (FID 2.07) into a challenger (1.55) to the previous SOTA model (1.48) [17], and with training improvements achieved a SOTA FID of 1.36. We also obtained new state-of-the-art results on CIFAR-10 while using only 35 model evaluations, deterministic sampling, and a small network. The current high-resolution diffusion models rely either on separate super-resolution steps [17, 36, 40], subspace projection [23], very large networks [9, 49], or hybrid approaches [39, 42, 53] — we believe that our contributions are orthogonal to these extensions. That said, many of our parameter values may need to be re-adjusted for higher-resolution datasets. Furthermore, we feel that the precise interaction between stochastic sampling and the training objective remains an interesting question for future work.
paras.zh: 我们将扩散模型置于一个统一框架中的方法揭示了其模块化设计。这使得能够针对性地研究各个组件，从而可能更好地覆盖可行的设计空间。在我们的测试中，这让我们能够简单地替换各种早期模型中的采样器，从而大幅改进结果。例如，在 ImageNet-64 上，我们的采样器将一个平均水平的模型（FID 2.07）转变为挑战者（1.55），逼近之前的最优模型（1.48）[17]，并通过训练改进达到了 1.36 的最优 FID。我们还在仅使用 35 次模型评估、确定性采样和小型网络的情况下，在 CIFAR-10 上取得了新的最优结果。当前的高分辨率扩散模型要么依赖独立的超分辨率步骤 [17, 36, 40]、子空间投影 [23]、非常大的网络 [9, 49]，要么采用混合方法 [39, 42, 53]——我们相信我们的贡献与这些扩展是正交的。尽管如此，我们的许多参数值可能需要针对更高分辨率的数据集重新调整。此外，我们认为随机采样与训练目标之间的精确交互仍是一个有趣的未来研究方向。

paras.en: Societal impact. Our advances in sample quality can potentially amplify negative societal effects when used in a large-scale system like DALL·E 2, including types of disinformation or emphasizing stereotypes and harmful biases [34]. The training and sampling of diffusion models needs a lot of electricity; our project consumed ∼250MWh on an in-house cluster of NVIDIA V100s.

paras.en: B Derivation of formulas B.1 Original ODE / SDE formulation from previous work
paras.zh: B 公式推导 B.1 先前工作中的原始ODE/SDE公式

paras.en: Song et al. [49] define their forward SDE (Eq. 5 in [49]) as dx = f (x, t) dt + g(t) dωt , (9) where ωt is the standard Wiener process and f (·, t) : Rd → Rd and g(·) : R → R are the drift and diffusion coefficients, respectively, where d is the dimensionality of the dataset. These coefficients are selected differently for the variance preserving (VP) and variance exploding (VE) formulations, and f (·) is always of the form f (x, t) = f (t) x, where f (·) : R → R. Thus, the SDE can be equivalently written as dx = f (t) x dt + g(t) dωt . (10)
paras.zh: Song等人 [49]将他们的前向SDE（[49]中的公式5）定义为dx = f (x, t) dt + g(t) dωt , (9)，其中ωt是标准维纳过程，f (·, t) : Rd → Rd和g(·) : R → R分别是漂移和扩散系数，其中d是数据集的维度。这些系数在方差保持（VP）和方差爆炸（VE）公式中选择不同，且f (·)总是具有f (x, t) = f (t) x的形式，其中f (·) : R → R。因此，SDE可以等价地写成dx = f (t) x dt + g(t) dωt . (10)

paras.en: The perturbation kernels of this SDE (Eq. 29 in [49]) have the general form p0t (x(t) | x(0)) = N (x(t); s(t) x(0), s(t)^2 σ(t)^2 I), (11) where N (x; μ, Σ) denotes the probability density function of N (μ, Σ) evaluated at x, s(t) = exp(∫_0^t f(ξ) dξ), and σ(t) = sqrt(∫_0^t g(ξ)^2 / s(ξ)^2 dξ). (12)
paras.zh: 该 SDE 的扰动核（[49] 中方程 29）具有一般形式 p0t (x(t) | x(0)) = N (x(t); s(t) x(0), s(t)^2 σ(t)^2 I)，(11) 其中 N (x; μ, Σ) 表示 N (μ, Σ) 在 x 处评估的概率密度函数，s(t) = exp(∫_0^t f(ξ) dξ)，且 σ(t) = sqrt(∫_0^t g(ξ)^2 / s(ξ)^2 dξ)。(12)

paras.en: The marginal distribution \(p_t(x)\) is obtained by integrating the perturbation kernels over \(x(0)\): \[ p_t(x) = \int_{\mathbb{R}^d} p_{0t}(x | x_0) p_{\text{data}}(x_0) , dx_0 . \tag{13} \]
paras.zh: 边际分布 \(p_t(x)\) 通过对扰动核在 \(x(0)\) 上积分得到：\[ p_t(x) = \int_{\mathbb{R}^d} p_{0t}(x | x_0) p_{\text{data}}(x_0) , dx_0 . \tag{13} \]

paras.en: Song et al. [49] define the probability flow ODE (Eq. 13 in [49]) so that it obeys this same \(p_t(x)\): \[ dx = \left( f(t) , x - \frac{1}{2} g(t)^2 \nabla_x \log p_t(x) \right) dt . \tag{14} \]
paras.zh: Song 等 [49] 定义了概率流 ODE（见 [49] 中的式 (13)），使其满足同样的 \(p_t(x)\)：\[ dx = \left( f(t) , x - \frac{1}{2} g(t)^2 \nabla_x \log p_t(x) \right) dt . \tag{14} \]

paras.en: The original ODE formulation (Eq. 14) is built around the functions f and g that correspond directly to specific terms that appear in the formula; the properties of the marginal distribution (Eq. 12) can only be derived indirectly based on these functions. However, f and g are of little practical interest in themselves, whereas the marginal distributions are of utmost importance in terms of training the model in the first place, bootstrapping the sampling process, and understanding how the ODE behaves in practice. Given that the idea of the probability flow ODE is to match a particular set of marginal distributions.
paras.zh: 原始 ODE 公式（式 (14)）围绕函数 f 和 g 构建，它们直接对应于公式中出现的特定项；边际分布（式 (12)）的性质只能通过这些函数间接推导。然而，f 和 g 本身几乎没有实用价值，而边际分布在训练模型、引导采样过程以及理解 ODE 在实际中的表现方面至关重要。鉴于概率流 ODE 的思想是匹配一组特定的边际分布。

We derive the SDE of Eq. 6 by the following strategy: • The desired marginal densities p(x; σ(t)) are convolutions of the data density p_data and an isotropic Gaussian density with standard deviation σ(t) (see Eq. 20). Hence, considered as a function of the time t, the density evolves according to a heat diffusion PDE with time-varying diffusivity. As a first step, we find this PDE. • We then use the Fokker–Planck equation to recover a family of SDEs for which the density evolves according to this PDE. Eq. 6 is obtained from a suitable parametrization of this family.
paras.zh: 我们通过以下策略推导式(6)中的 SDE：• 所需的边际密度 p(x; σ(t)) 是数据密度 p_data 与标准差为 σ(t) 的各向同性高斯密度的卷积（见式(20)）。因此，作为时间 t 的函数，该密度根据具有时变扩散系数的热扩散偏微分方程演化。作为第一步，我们找到这个偏微分方程。• 然后我们利用 Fokker–Planck 方程恢复一族 SDE，使得密度根据该偏微分方程演化。式(6)通过对这一族进行适当的参数化得到。

paras.en: B.5.1 Generating the marginals by heat diffusion We consider the time evolution of a probability density q(x, t). Our goal is to find a PDE whose solution with the initial value q(x, 0) := pdata (x) is q(x, t) = p(x, σ(t)). That is, the PDE should reproduce the marginals we postulate in Eq. 20. The desired marginals are convolutions of pdata with isotropic normal distributions of time-varying standard deviation σ(t), and as such, can be generated by the heat equation with time-varying diffusivity κ(t). The situation is most conveniently analyzed in the Fourier domain, where the marginal densities are simply pointwise products of a Gaussian function and the transformed data density. To find the diffusivity that induces the correct standard deviations, we first write down the heat equation PDE: ∂q(x, t)/∂t = κ(t)∆x q(x, t). (82) The Fourier transformed counterpart of Eq. 82, where the transform is taken along the x-dimension, is given by ∂q̂(ν, t)/∂t = −κ(t)|ν|² q̂(ν, t). (83) The target solution q(x, t) and its Fourier transform q̂(ν, t) are given by Eq. 20: q(x, t) = p(x; σ(t)) = pdata (x) ∗ N(0, σ(t)² I) (84) q̂(ν, t) = p̂data (ν) exp(−½ |ν|² σ(t)²). (85)
paras.zh: B.5.1 通过热扩散生成边际分布 我们考虑概率密度 q(x, t) 的时间演化。我们的目标是找到一个偏微分方程（PDE），其以初始值 q(x, 0) := pdata (x) 的解为 q(x, t) = p(x, σ(t))。也就是说，该 PDE 应重现我们在式 (20) 中假设的边际分布。所需的边际分布是 pdata 与具有时变标准差 σ(t) 的各向同性正态分布的卷积，因此可以通过具有时变扩散系数 κ(t) 的热方程生成。这种情况在傅里叶域中分析最为方便，其中边际密度只是高斯函数与变换后的数据密度的逐点乘积。为了找到能产生正确标准差的扩散系数，我们首先写出热方程 PDE：∂q(x, t)/∂t = κ(t)∆x q(x, t。 (82) 式 (82) 的傅里叶变换对应形式（沿 x 维进行变换）为 ∂q̂(ν, t)/∂t = −κ(t)|ν|² q̂(ν, t)。 (83) 目标解 q(x, t) 及其傅里叶变换 q̂(ν, t) 由式 (20) 给出：q(x, t) = p(x; σ(t)) = pdata (x) ∗ N(0, σ(t)² I) (84) q̂(ν, t) = p̂data (ν) exp(−½ |ν|² σ(t)²)。 (85)

paras.en: 25 Differentiating the target solution along the time axis, we have ∂q̂(ν, t)/∂t = −σ̇(t)σ(t) |ν|² p̂data (ν) exp(−½ |ν|² σ(t)²) (86) = −σ̇(t)σ(t) |ν|² q̂(ν, t). (87)
paras.zh: 25 沿时间轴对目标解求导，我们有 ∂q̂(ν, t)/∂t = −σ̇(t)σ(t) |ν|² p̂data (ν) exp(−½ |ν|² σ(t)²) (86) = −σ̇(t)σ(t) |ν|² q̂(ν, t)。 (87)

paras.en: Eqs. 83 and 87 share the same left hand side. Equating them allows us to solve for κ(t) that generates the desired evolution: −κ(t)|ν|² q̂(ν, t) = −σ̇(t)σ(t) |ν|² q̂(ν, t) (88) κ(t) = σ̇(t)σ(t). (89)
paras.zh: 式 (83) 和 (87) 具有相同的左边。令它们相等，我们可以解出产生所需演化的 κ(t)：−κ(t)|ν|² q̂(ν, t) = −σ̇(t)σ(t) |ν|² q̂(ν, t) (88) κ(t) = σ̇(t)σ(t)。 (89)

paras.en: To summarize, the desired marginal densities corresponding to noise levels σ(t) are generated by the PDE ∂q(x, t) = σ̇(t)σ(t)∆x q(x, t) (90) ∂t from the initial density q(x, 0) = pdata (x).
paras.zh: 总之，与噪声水平 σ(t) 对应的期望边际密度由偏微分方程 ∂q(x, t) = σ̇(t)σ(t)∆x q(x, t) (90) ∂t 从初始密度 q(x, 0) = pdata (x) 生成。

paras.en: B.5.2 Derivation of our SDE Given an SDE dx = f (x, t) dt + g(x, t) dωt , (91) the Fokker–Planck PDE describes the time evolution of its solution probability density r(x, t) as ∂r(x, t) = −∇x · f (x, t) r(x, t) + 21 ∇x ∇x : D(x, t) r(x, t) ,   (92) ∂t P where Dij = k g ik g jk is the diffusion tensor. We consider the special case g(x, t) = g(t) I of x-independent white noise addition, whereby the equation simplifies to ∂r(x, t) = −∇x · f (x, t) r(x, t) + 12 g(t)2 ∆x r(x, t).  (93) ∂t
paras.zh: B.5.2 我们 SDE 的推导 给定 SDE dx = f (x, t) dt + g(x, t) dωt ，(91) Fokker–Planck 偏微分方程描述其解的概率密度 r(x, t) 的时间演化为 ∂r(x, t) = −∇x · f (x, t) r(x, t) + 21 ∇x ∇x : D(x, t) r(x, t) ，(92) ∂t 其中 Dij = k g ik g jk 是扩散张量。我们考虑特殊情况 g(x, t) = g(t) I，即与 x 无关的白噪声添加，此时方程简化为 ∂r(x, t) = −∇x · f (x, t) r(x, t) + 12 g(t)2 ∆x r(x, t)。(93) ∂t

paras.en: We are seeking an SDE whose solution density is described by the PDE in Eq. 90. Setting r(x, t) = q(x, t) and equating Eqs. 93 and 90, we find the sufficient condition that the SDE must satisfy −∇x · f (x, t) q(x, t) + 21 g(t)2 ∆x q(x, t) = σ̇(t) σ(t) ∆x q(x, t)  (94)   1 2  ∇x · f (x, t) q(x, t) = 2 g(t) − σ̇(t) σ(t) ∆x q(x, t). (95)
paras.zh: 我们寻求一个 SDE，其解密度由式 (90) 中的偏微分方程描述。令 r(x, t) = q(x, t) 并令式 (93) 与式 (90) 相等，我们找到 SDE 必须满足的充分条件：−∇x · f (x, t) q(x, t) + 21 g(t)2 ∆x q(x, t) = σ̇(t) σ(t) ∆x q(x, t) (94) 即 ∇x · f (x, t) q(x, t) = 21 g(t)2 − σ̇(t) σ(t) ∆x q(x, t)。(95)

paras.en:
Any choice of functions f(x, t) and g(t) satisfying this equation constitutes a sought-after SDE. Let us now find a specific family of such solutions. The key idea is given by the identity ∇x · ∇x = ∆x. Indeed, if we set f(x, t) q(x, t) = υ(t) ∇x q(x, t) for any choice of υ(t), the term ∆x q(x, t) appears on both sides and cancels out: 
\[ ∇x · (υ(t) ∇x q(x, t)) = \frac{1}{2} g(t)^2 - \dot{\sigma}(t) \sigma(t) \Delta_x q(x, t) \tag{96} \] 
\[ υ(t) \Delta_x q(x, t) = \frac{1}{2} g(t)^2 - \dot{\sigma}(t) \sigma(t) \Delta_x q(x, t) \tag{97} \] 
\[ \frac{1}{2} υ(t) = \frac{1}{2} g(t)^2 - \dot{\sigma}(t) \sigma(t) \tag{98} \]
paras.zh:
任何满足该方程的函数 f(x, t) 和 g(t) 的选择都构成一个所寻求的 SDE。现在让我们找到这样一组具体的解。关键思想由恒等式 ∇x · ∇x = ∆x 给出。事实上，如果我们对任意 υ(t) 令 f(x, t) q(x, t) = υ(t) ∇x q(x, t)，则 ∆x q(x, t) 项在两边出现并相互抵消： 
\[ ∇x · (υ(t) ∇x q(x, t)) = \frac{1}{2} g(t)^2 - \dot{\sigma}(t) \sigma(t) \Delta_x q(x, t) \tag{96} \] 
\[ υ(t) \Delta_x q(x, t) = \frac{1}{2} g(t)^2 - \dot{\sigma}(t) \sigma(t) \Delta_x q(x, t) \tag{97} \] 
\[ \frac{1}{2} υ(t) = \frac{1}{2} g(t)^2 - \dot{\sigma}(t) \sigma(t) \tag{98} \]

paras.en:
The stated f(x, t) is in fact proportional to the score function, as the formula matches the gradient of the logarithm of the density: 
\[ f(x, t) = υ(t) \frac{\nabla_x q(x, t)}{q(x, t)} \tag{99} \] 
\[ = υ(t) \nabla_x \log q(x, t) \tag{100} \] 
\[ = \frac{1}{2} g(t)^2 - \dot{\sigma}(t) \sigma(t) \nabla_x \log q(x, t) \tag{101} \]
paras.zh:
所给出的 f(x, t) 实际上与得分函数成正比，因为该公式与密度对数的梯度相匹配： 
\[ f(x, t) = υ(t) \frac{\nabla_x q(x, t)}{q(x, t)} \tag{99} \] 
\[ = υ(t) \nabla_x \log q(x, t) \tag{100} \] 
\[ = \frac{1}{2} g(t)^2 - \dot{\sigma}(t) \sigma(t) \nabla_x \log q(x, t) \tag{101} \]

paras.en:
Substituting this back into Eq. 91 and writing p(x; σ(t)) in place of q(x, t), we recover a family of SDEs whose solution densities have the desired marginals with noise levels σ(t) for any choice of g(t): 
\[ dx = \frac{1}{2} g(t)^2 - \dot{\sigma}(t) \sigma(t) \nabla_x \log p(x; \sigma(t)) dt + g(t) d\omega_t \tag{102} \]
paras.zh:
将其代回方程 (91)，并用 p(x; σ(t)) 代替 q(x, t)，我们恢复了一族 SDE，其解密度具有所需的边缘分布，噪声水平为 σ(t)，且对任意 g(t) 成立： 
\[ dx = \frac{1}{2} g(t)^2 - \dot{\sigma}(t) \sigma(t) \nabla_x \log p(x; \sigma(t)) dt + g(t) d\omega_t \tag{102} \]

paras.en: The free parameter g(t) effectively specifies the rate of noise replacement at any given time instance. The special case choice of g(t) = 0 corresponds to the probability flow ODE. The parametrization by g(t) is not particularly intuitive, however. To obtain a more interpretable parametrization, we set g(t) = 2 β(t) σ(t), which yields the (forward) SDE of Eq. 6 in the main paper: dx+ = −σ̇(t)σ(t)∇x log p(x; σ(t)) dt + β(t)σ(t)^2 ∇x log p(x; σ(t)) dt + 2β(t)σ(t) dωt. (103) The noise replacement is now proportional to the standard deviation σ(t) of the noise, with the proportionality factor β(t). Indeed, expanding the score function in the middle term according to Eq. 3 yields β(t)(D(x; σ(t)) − x) dt, which changes x proportionally to the negative noise component; the stochastic term injects new noise at the same rate. Intuitively, scaling the magnitude of Langevin exploration according to the current noise standard deviation is a reasonable baseline, as the data manifold is effectively “spread out” by this amount due to the blurring of the density. The reverse SDE used in denoising diffusion is simply obtained by applying the time reversal formula of Anderson [1] (as stated in Eq. 6 of Song et al. [49]) on Eq. 103; the entire effect of the reversal is a change of sign in the middle term. The scaled generalization of the SDE can be derived using a similar approach as with the ODE previously. As such, the derivation is omitted here.
paras.zh: 自由参数 g(t) 有效地指定了任意时刻噪声替换的速率。特殊情况 g(t) = 0 对应于概率流 ODE。然而，通过 g(t) 的参数化并不特别直观。为了获得更具可解释性的参数化，我们设置 g(t) = 2 β(t) σ(t)，这产生了主论文中 Eq. 6 的（前向）SDE：dx+ = −σ̇(t)σ(t)∇x log p(x; σ(t)) dt + β(t)σ(t)^2 ∇x log p(x; σ(t)) dt + 2β(t)σ(t) dωt。 (103) 现在噪声替换与噪声的标准差 σ(t) 成正比，比例因子为 β(t)。实际上，根据 Eq. 3 展开中间项的得分函数，得到 β(t)(D(x; σ(t)) − x) dt，它使 x 与负噪声分量成比例变化；随机项以相同的速率注入新噪声。直观地说，根据当前噪声标准差来缩放 Langevin 探索的幅度是一个合理的基线，因为数据流形由于密度的模糊而有效地被“展开”了这么多。去噪扩散中使用的反向 SDE 只需将 Anderson [1] 的时间反转公式（如 Song 等人 [49] 的 Eq. 6 所述）应用于 Eq. 103 即可获得；反转的全部效果是中间项符号的改变。SDE 的缩放泛化可以使用与之前 ODE 类似的方法推导。因此，此处省略推导。

paras.en: Following Eq. 2, the denoising score matching loss for a given denoiser \(D_{\theta}\) on a given noise level \(\sigma\) is given by \[ L(D_{\theta}; \sigma) = \mathbb{E}_{y \sim p_{\text{data}}} \mathbb{E}_{n \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2 I)} \lVert D_{\theta}(y + n; \sigma) - y \rVert_2^2 . \tag{104} \]
paras.zh: 根据式 2，给定去噪器 \(D_{\theta}\) 和噪声水平 \(\sigma\)，去噪分数匹配损失为 \[ L(D_{\theta}; \sigma) = \mathbb{E}_{y \sim p_{\text{data}}} \mathbb{E}_{n \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2 I)} \lVert D_{\theta}(y + n; \sigma) - y \rVert_2^2 . \tag{104} \]

paras.en: We obtain the overall training loss by taking a weighted expectation of \(L(D_{\theta}; \sigma)\) over the noise levels: \[ L(D_{\theta}) = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma \sim p_{\text{train}}} \lambda(\sigma) L(D_{\theta}; \sigma) \tag{105} \] \[ = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma \sim p_{\text{train}}} \lambda(\sigma) \mathbb{E}_{y \sim p_{\text{data}}} \mathbb{E}_{n \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2 I)} \lVert D_{\theta}(y + n; \sigma) - y \rVert_2^2 \tag{106} \] \[ = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma \sim p_{\text{train}}} \mathbb{E}_{y \sim p_{\text{data}}} \mathbb{E}_{n \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2 I)} \lambda(\sigma) \lVert D_{\theta}(y + n; \sigma) - y \rVert_2^2 \tag{107} \] \[ = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma, y, n} \lambda(\sigma) \lVert D_{\theta}(y + n; \sigma) - y \rVert_2^2 , \tag{108} \]
paras.zh: 我们通过对噪声水平取加权期望来得到整体训练损失：\[ L(D_{\theta}) = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma \sim p_{\text{train}}} \lambda(\sigma) L(D_{\theta}; \sigma) \tag{105} \] \[ = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma \sim p_{\text{train}}} \lambda(\sigma) \mathbb{E}_{y \sim p_{\text{data}}} \mathbb{E}_{n \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2 I)} \lVert D_{\theta}(y + n; \sigma) - y \rVert_2^2 \tag{106} \] \[ = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma \sim p_{\text{train}}} \mathbb{E}_{y \sim p_{\text{data}}} \mathbb{E}_{n \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2 I)} \lambda(\sigma) \lVert D_{\theta}(y + n; \sigma) - y \rVert_2^2 \tag{107} \] \[ = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma, y, n} \lambda(\sigma) \lVert D_{\theta}(y + n; \sigma) - y \rVert_2^2 , \tag{108} \]

paras.en: where the noise levels are distributed according to \(\sigma \sim p_{\text{train}}\) and weighted by \(\lambda(\sigma)\). Using our definition of \(D_{\theta}(\cdot)\) from Eq. 7, we can further rewrite \(L(D_{\theta})\) as \[ \mathbb{E}_{\sigma, y, n} \lambda(\sigma) \lVert c_{\text{skip}}(\sigma)(y+n) + c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)F_{\theta}(c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)(y+n); c_{\text{noise}}(\sigma)) - y \rVert_2^2 \tag{109} \] \[ = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma, y, n} \lambda(\sigma) \lVert c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)F_{\theta}(c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)(y+n); c_{\text{noise}}(\sigma)) - (y - c_{\text{skip}}(\sigma)(y + n)) \rVert_2^2 \tag{110} \] \[ = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma, y, n} \lambda(\sigma)c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)^2 \lVert F_{\theta}(c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)(y+n); c_{\text{noise}}(\sigma)) - c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)^{-1}(y - c_{\text{skip}}(\sigma)(y+n)) \rVert_2^2 \tag{111} \] \[ = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma, y, n} w(\sigma) \lVert F_{\theta}(c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)(y+n); c_{\text{noise}}(\sigma)) - F_{\text{target}}(y, n; \sigma) \rVert_2^2 , \tag{112} \] which matches Eq. 8 and corresponds to traditional supervised training of \(F_{\theta}\) using standard L2 loss with effective weight \(w(\cdot)\) and target \(F_{\text{target}}(\cdot)\) given by \[ w(\sigma) = \lambda(\sigma) c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)^2 , \quad F_{\text{target}}(y, n; \sigma) = c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)^{-1}(y - c_{\text{skip}}(\sigma)(y + n)) . \tag{113} \]
paras.zh: 其中噪声水平按 \(\sigma \sim p_{\text{train}}\) 分布，并由 \(\lambda(\sigma)\) 加权。利用我们在式 7 中对 \(D_{\theta}(\cdot)\) 的定义，可以将 \(L(D_{\theta})\) 进一步改写为 \[ \mathbb{E}_{\sigma, y, n} \lambda(\sigma) \lVert c_{\text{skip}}(\sigma)(y+n) + c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)F_{\theta}(c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)(y+n); c_{\text{noise}}(\sigma)) - y \rVert_2^2 \tag{109} \] \[ = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma, y, n} \lambda(\sigma) \lVert c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)F_{\theta}(c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)(y+n); c_{\text{noise}}(\sigma)) - (y - c_{\text{skip}}(\sigma)(y + n)) \rVert_2^2 \tag{110} \] \[ = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma, y, n} \lambda(\sigma)c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)^2 \lVert F_{\theta}(c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)(y+n); c_{\text{noise}}(\sigma)) - c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)^{-1}(y - c_{\text{skip}}(\sigma)(y+n)) \rVert_2^2 \tag{111} \] \[ = \mathbb{E}_{\sigma, y, n} w(\sigma) \lVert F_{\theta}(c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)(y+n); c_{\text{noise}}(\sigma)) - F_{\text{target}}(y, n; \sigma) \rVert_2^2 , \tag{112} \] 这与式 8 一致，对应于使用标准 L2 损失对 \(F_{\theta}\) 进行传统监督训练，其中有效权重 \(w(\cdot)\) 和目标 \(F_{\text{target}}(\cdot)\) 为 \[ w(\sigma) = \lambda(\sigma) c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)^2 , \quad F_{\text{target}}(y, n; \sigma) = c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)^{-1}(y - c_{\text{skip}}(\sigma)(y + n)) . \tag{113} \]

paras.en: We can now derive formulas for \(c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)\), \(c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)\), \(c_{\text{skip}}(\sigma)\), and \(\lambda(\sigma)\) from first principles, shown in the “Ours” column of Table 1.
paras.zh: 我们现在可以从第一性原理推导出 \(c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)\)、\(c_{\text{out}}(\sigma)\)、\(c_{\text{skip}}(\sigma)\) 和 \(\lambda(\sigma)\) 的公式，如表 1 的“Ours”列所示。

paras.en: First, we require the training inputs of \(F_{\theta}(\cdot)\) to have unit variance: \[ \operatorname{Var}_{y,n}[c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)(y + n)] = 1 \tag{114} \] \[ c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)^2 \operatorname{Var}_{y,n}[y + n] = 1 \tag{115} \] \[ c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)^2 (\sigma_{\text{data}}^2 + \sigma^2) = 1 \tag{116} \] \[ c_{\text{in}}(\sigma) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\sigma^2 + \sigma_{\text{data}}^2}} \tag{117} \]
paras.zh: 首先，我们要求 \(F_{\theta}(\cdot)\) 的训练输入具有单位方差：\[ \operatorname{Var}_{y,n}[c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)(y + n)] = 1 \tag{114} \] \[ c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)^2 \operatorname{Var}_{y,n}[y + n] = 1 \tag{115} \] \[ c_{\text{in}}(\sigma)^2 (\sigma_{\text{data}}^2 + \sigma^2) = 1 \tag{116} \] \[ c_{\text{in}}(\sigma) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\sigma^2 + \sigma_{\text{data}}^2}} \tag{117} \]

paras.en: Second, we require the effective training target Ftarget to have unit variance: Var_{y,n}[Ftarget(y, n; σ)] = 1 (118) 1 Var_{y,n}[cout(σ)(y − cskip(σ)(y + n))] = 1 (119) 1 cout(σ)^2 Var_{y,n}[y − cskip(σ)(y + n)] = 1 (120) 2 cout(σ) = Var_{y,n}[y − cskip(σ)(y + n)] (121) cout(σ)^2 = Var_{y,n}[(1 − cskip(σ)) y + cskip(σ) n] (122)
paras.zh: 其次，我们要求有效训练目标 Ftarget 具有单位方差：Var_{y,n}[Ftarget(y, n; σ)] = 1 (118) 1 Var_{y,n}[cout(σ)(y − cskip(σ)(y + n))] = 1 (119) 1 cout(σ)^2 Var_{y,n}[y − cskip(σ)(y + n)] = 1 (120) 2 cout(σ) = Var_{y,n}[y − cskip(σ)(y + n)] (121) cout(σ)^2 = Var_{y,n}[(1 − cskip(σ)) y + cskip(σ) n] (122)

paras.en: 2 2 cout (σ)2 = 1 − cskip (σ) σdata + cskip (σ)2 σ 2 . (123)

paras.en: In this section, we derive the formulas shown in Table 1 for previous methods, discuss the corresponding original samplers and pre-trained models, and detail the practical considerations associated with using them in our framework. In practice, the original implementations of these methods differ considerably in terms of the definitions of model inputs and outputs, dynamic range of image data, scaling of x, and interpretation of σ. We eliminate this variation by standardizing on a unified setup where the model always matches our definition of Fθ, image data is always represented in the continuous range [−1, 1], and the details of x and σ are always in agreement with Eq. 4. We minimize the accumulation of floating point round-off errors by always executing Algorithms 1 and 2 at double precision (float64). However, we still execute the network Fθ(·) at single precision (float32) to minimize runtime and remain faithful to previous work in terms of network architecture.
paras.zh: 在本节中，我们推导了表 1 中先前方法的公式，讨论了相应的原始采样器和预训练模型，并详细说明了在我们的框架中使用它们的实际考虑。在实践中，这些方法的原始实现在模型输入和输出的定义、图像数据的动态范围、x 的缩放以及 σ 的解释方面存在显著差异。我们通过统一设置来消除这种差异：模型始终匹配我们对 Fθ 的定义，图像数据始终表示为连续范围 [−1, 1]，且 x 和 σ 的细节始终与式 (4) 一致。我们始终以双精度（float64）执行算法 1 和 2，以最小化浮点舍入误差的累积。然而，我们仍以单精度（float32）执行网络 Fθ(·)，以最小化运行时间，并在网络架构方面忠实于先前的工作。

paras.en: The pre-trained VP model that we use on CIFAR-10 corresponds to the “DDPM++ cont. (VP)” checkpoint provided by Song et al. [49]. It contains a total of 62 million trainable parameters and supports a continuous range of noise levels σ ∈ [σ(t_min), σ(1)] ≈ [0.001, 152], i.e., wider than our preferred sampling range [0.002, 80]. We import the model directly as F_θ(·) and run Algorithms 1 and 2 using the definitions in Table 1. In Figure 2a, the differences between the original sampler (blue) and our reimplementation (orange) are explained by oversights in the implementation of Song et al. [49], also noted by Jolicoeur-Martineau et al. [24] (Appendix D in [24]). First, the original sampler employs an incorrect multiplier in the Euler step: it multiplies dx/dt by −1/N instead of (σ_s − 1)/(N − 1). Second, it either overshoots or undershoots on the last step by going from t_{N−1} = σ_s to t_N = σ_s − 1/N, where t_N < 0 when N < 1000. In practice, this means that the generated images contain noticeable noise that becomes quite severe with, e.g., N = 128. Our formulation avoids these issues, because the step sizes in Algorithm 1 are computed consistently from {t_i} and t_N = 0.

paras.en: C.2.5 VE practical considerations The pre-trained VE model that we use on CIFAR-10 corresponds to the “NCSN++ cont. (VE)” checkpoint provided by Song et al. [49]. It contains a total of 63 million trainable parameters and supports a continuous range of noise levels σ ∈ [σ(0), σ(1)] ≈ [0.02, 100]. This is narrower than our preferred sampling range [0.002, 80], so we set σ_min = 0.02 in all related experiments. Note that this limitation is lifted by our training improvements in config E, so we revert back to using σ_min = 0.002 with configs E and F in Table 2. When importing the model, we remove the pre- and postprocessing steps shown in Eq. 212 to stay consistent with the definition of Fθ(·) in Eq. 217. With these changes, we can run Algorithms 1 and 2 using the definitions in Table 1. In Figure 2b, the differences between the original sampler (blue) and our reimplementation (orange) are explained by floating point round-off errors that the original implementation suffers from at high step counts. Our results are more accurate in these cases because we represent x_i at double precision in Algorithm 1.

paras.en: C.3.1 DDIM ODE formulation Song et al. [47] make the observation that their deterministic DDIM sampler can be expressed as Euler integration of the following ODE (Eq. 14 in [47]): \[ \frac{dx(t)}{dt} = \frac{\epsilon_\theta(x(t), t)}{\sqrt{\sigma(t)^2 + 1}} \frac{d\sigma(t)}{dt}, \tag{223} \] where \(x(t)\) is a scaled version of the iterate that appears in their discrete update formula (Eq. 10 in [47]) and \(\epsilon_\theta\) is a model trained to predict the normalized noise vector, i.e., \(\epsilon_\theta(x(t)/\sqrt{\sigma(t)^2 + 1}) \approx n(t)/\sigma(t)\) for \(x(t) = y(t) + n(t)\). In our formulation, \(D_\theta\) is trained to approximate the clean signal, i.e., \(D_\theta(x(t); \sigma(t)) \approx y\), so we can reinterpret \(\epsilon_\theta\) in terms of \(D_\theta\) as follows: \[ n(t) = x(t) - y(t) \tag{224} \] \[ n(t)/\sigma(t) = (x(t) - y(t))/\sigma(t) \tag{225} \] \[ \epsilon_\theta(x(t)/\sqrt{\sigma(t)^2 + 1}) = (x(t) - D_\theta(x(t); \sigma(t)))/\sigma(t). \tag{226} \]
paras.zh: C.3.1 DDIM ODE 公式 Song 等人 [47] 观察到他们的确定性 DDIM 采样器可以表示为以下 ODE 的欧拉积分（[47] 中的公式 14）：\[ \frac{dx(t)}{dt} = \frac{\epsilon_\theta(x(t), t)}{\sqrt{\sigma(t)^2 + 1}} \frac{d\sigma(t)}{dt}, \tag{223} \] 其中 \(x(t)\) 是其离散更新公式（[47] 中的公式 10）中出现的迭代的缩放版本，\(\epsilon_\theta\) 是训练用于预测归一化噪声向量的模型，即对于 \(x(t) = y(t) + n(t)\)，有 \(\epsilon_\theta(x(t)/\sqrt{\sigma(t)^2 + 1}) \approx n(t)/\sigma(t)\)。在我们的公式中，\(D_\theta\) 被训练用于近似干净信号，即 \(D_\theta(x(t); \sigma(t)) \approx y\)，因此我们可以将 \(\epsilon_\theta\) 用 \(D_\theta\) 重新解释如下：\[ n(t) = x(t) - y(t) \tag{224} \] \[ n(t)/\sigma(t) = (x(t) - y(t))/\sigma(t) \tag{225} \] \[ \epsilon_\theta(x(t)/\sqrt{\sigma(t)^2 + 1}) = (x(t) - D_\theta(x(t); \sigma(t)))/\sigma(t). \tag{226} \]

paras.en: Assuming ideal \(\epsilon(\cdot)\) and \(D(\cdot)\) in L2 sense, we can further simplify the above formula using Eq. 3: \[ \epsilon(x(t)/\sqrt{\sigma(t)^2 + 1}) = (x(t) - D(x(t); \sigma(t)))/\sigma(t) \tag{227} \] \[ = -\sigma(t) \left( D(x(t); \sigma(t)) - x(t) \right)/\sigma(t)^2 \tag{228} \] \[ = -\sigma(t) \nabla_{x(t)} \log p(x(t); \sigma(t)). \tag{229} \]
paras.zh: 假设在 L2 意义上 \(\epsilon(\cdot)\) 和 \(D(\cdot)\) 是理想的，我们可以使用公式 3 进一步简化上述公式：\[ \epsilon(x(t)/\sqrt{\sigma(t)^2 + 1}) = (x(t) - D(x(t); \sigma(t)))/\sigma(t) \tag{227} \] \[ = -\sigma(t) \left( D(x(t); \sigma(t)) - x(t) \right)/\sigma(t)^2 \tag{228} \] \[ = -\sigma(t) \nabla_{x(t)} \log p(x(t); \sigma(t)). \tag{229} \]

paras.en: Substituting Eq. 229 back into Eq. 223 gives \[ dx(t) = -\sigma(t) \nabla_{x(t)} \log p(x(t); \sigma(t)) \, d\sigma(t), \tag{230} \] which we can further simplify by setting \(\sigma(t) = t\): \[ dx = -t \nabla_x \log p(x; \sigma(t)) \, dt. \tag{231} \] This matches our Eq. 4 with \(s(t) = 1\) and \(\sigma(t) = t\), reflected by the “Sampling” section of Table 1.

paras.en: C.3.4 iDDPM practical considerations The pre-trained iDDPM model that we use on ImageNet-64 corresponds to the “ADM (dropout)” checkpoint17 provided by Dhariwal and Nichol [9]. It contains 296 million trainable parameters and supports a discrete set of M = 1000 noise levels σ ∈ {uj } ≈ {20291, 642, 321, 214, 160, 128, 106, 92, 80, 71, . . . , 0.0064}. The fact that we can only evaluate Fθ at these specific choices of σ presents three practical challenges:
paras.zh: C.3.4 iDDPM 实际考虑 我们在 ImageNet-64 上使用的预训练 iDDPM 模型对应于 Dhariwal 和 Nichol [9] 提供的“ADM (dropout)”检查点17。该模型包含 2.96 亿个可训练参数，并支持 M = 1000 个离散噪声水平 σ ∈ {uj } ≈ {20291, 642, 321, 214, 160, 128, 106, 92, 80, 71, . . . , 0.0064}。我们只能在这些特定的 σ 值上评估 Fθ，这一事实带来了三个实际挑战：

paras.en: 1. In the context of DDIM, we must choose how to resample {uj } to yield {ti } for N ≠ M. Song et al. [47] employ a simple resampling scheme where ti = uk·i for resampling factor k ∈ Z+. This scheme, however, requires that 1000 ≡ 0 (mod N), which limits the possible choices for N considerably. Nichol and Dhariwal [37], on the other hand, employ a more flexible scheme where ti = uj with j = ⌊(M − 1)/(N − 1) · i⌋. We note, however, that in practice the values of uj<8 are considerably larger than our preferred σmax = 80. We choose to skip these values by defining j = ⌊j0 + (M − 1 − j0)/(N − 1) · i⌋ with j0 = 8, matching the “Time steps” row in Table 1. In Figure 2c, the differences between the original sampler (blue) and our reimplementation (orange) are explained by this choice.
paras.zh: 1. 在 DDIM 的背景下，我们必须选择如何对 {uj } 进行重采样以得到 {ti }（当 N ≠ M 时）。Song 等人 [47] 采用了一种简单的重采样方案，其中 ti = uk·i，重采样因子 k ∈ Z+。然而，该方案要求 1000 ≡ 0 (mod N)，这大大限制了 N 的可能选择。另一方面，Nichol 和 Dhariwal [37] 采用了一种更灵活的方案，其中 ti = uj，且 j = ⌊(M − 1)/(N − 1) · i⌋。然而，我们注意到，在实践中，uj<8 的值远大于我们偏好的 σmax = 80。我们选择跳过这些值，通过定义 j = ⌊j0 + (M − 1 − j0)/(N − 1) · i⌋ 且 j0 = 8，与表 1 中的“时间步”行匹配。在图 2c 中，原始采样器（蓝色）与我们重新实现（橙色）之间的差异由此选择解释。

paras.en: 2. In the context of our time step discretization (Eq. 5), we must ensure that σi ∈ {uj }. We accomplish this by rounding each σi to its nearest supported counterpart, i.e., σi ← uarg minj |uj −σi |, and setting σmin = 0.0064 ≈ uN −1. This is sufficient, because Algorithm 1 only evaluates Dθ(·; σ) with σ ∈ {σi<N }.
paras.zh: 2. 在我们的时间步离散化（公式 5）的背景下，我们必须确保 σi ∈ {uj }。我们通过将每个 σi 四舍五入到其最近的支持值来实现，即 σi ← uarg minj |uj −σi |，并设置 σmin = 0.0064 ≈ uN −1。这已经足够，因为算法 1 仅对 σ ∈ {σi<N } 评估 Dθ(·; σ)。
